Create, list and disable accounts, and set their console passwords

Usage: byrle account <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create    Create an account
  disable   Disable an account. Its tokens stop working
  password  Set an account's console password, read from the first line of stdin
  list      List every account
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
